title: Concurrent requests can run the same job twice (race)
reason: The handler takes a lock, rechecks the state, then writes through an atomic rename; concurrent runs are already serialised.

title: Missing validation of the PORT environment variable
reason: The value is parsed and range-checked by the settings model before use.

title: No lint script defined
reason: Linting runs from the workspace root script; the package does not need its own.
